title: paeonia × suffruticosa f. rosea
intro: Paeonia × suffruticosa f. rosea, commonly known as Chinese Peony, is a plant species within the Paeonia genus that is known for its unique rose-colored flowers. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include promoting relaxation and reducing inflammation, and is believed to have a range of health benefits such as relieving anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia × suffruticosa f. rosea include its sedative and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including paeonol, paeoniflorin, and glycosides. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's therapeutic properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional Chinese medicine.
